dissent: If 'absent refused source-attest' is read as 'any refused attestation is absent from the Q mask', the claim is FALSE in source: a guard-passed, Q-refused attestation is appended to invocations and sets its subprofile bit (a_audit.py:24-25; q_inclusive.py:7); absence holds only for guard-refused attestation, and for journal.attestation in the delegated-refused case.

invocations preserves schedule chronology, not subprofile order; only the mask is positional. Independent delegated actions may execute out of profile order (e.g. race core 'publication-source-race' s_domain.py:135), so an invariant claiming invocations is a potential-ordered subsequence is falsifiable.
findings: Subprofile positions: potential is the order-preserving filter of profile['actions'] minus source_only verbs (register:/attempt:/atomic:/append:/collect:/source:/append-lose-reply/collect-open); requires are emptied; audit independently recomputes it: a_domain.py:11-12,15-19; a_audit.py:17-19 ('fixed independent Q invocation profile').

Delegated step: call=True ⇒ unchanged Q reducer runs on qp, action appended to invocations, decision taken from core: a_inclusive.py:11-15; a_split.py:10-14; audit mirror a_audit.py:21-24 with qa.enabled+qa.check on qp (a_audit.py:22-23).
Non-delegated step: entire Q core unchanged, so no invocation entry and no mask bit: a_audit.py:29; initial invocations=() a_domain.py:21-23, a_audit.py:10.

Mask equality: a_audit.py:32-35 require invocations inventory, outer done bit, and core.done==sum(1<<potential.index(a) for a in calls); restore re-derives per retained prefix 'fixed Q occurrence positions'/'retained actual Q invocation mask': adapter_traces.py:72-74; audit_case binds q_invoked to the recomputed call: check.py:118.

Refused source-attest has TWO layers (falsifiable split): guard-refused (no-captured-source/stale-collection/incomplete-inventory/incomplete-registry) leaves delegate=False ⇒ absent from invocations AND mask: guard_audit.py:70-82, guard_a.py:64-71, guard_b.py:71-78. Guard-passed but Q-refused (no-source/foreign-source/source-fork: q_inclusive.py:16-24, q_audit.py:50-61, q_split.py:14-22) is PRESENT in invocations and mask (q_inclusive.py:7 sets done before deny; a_audit.py:24 appends unconditionally); only journal.attestation is rolled back: a_audit.py:25, a_inclusive.py:15, a_split.py:14.

Falsifiable clauses: F1 invocation entry for non-delegated action; F2 delegated action missing from invocations; F3 mask bit set for a position whose action was never invoked (control adapter_traces.py:142 mutates exactly this); F4 popcount(done)!=len(invocations); F5 renumbered potential positions (controls adapter_traces.py:150, check.py:217, check.py:214 row-flag flip); F6 guard-refused attest present in mask; F7 delegated-refused attest absent from mask or journal.attestation committed despite Q refusal.

Missing premises: P1 guard_a/guard_b/guard_audit agreement on the delegate bit over ALL reachable views (per-step agreement asserted only on executed cases, adapter_traces.py run loop); P2 inherited Q audit completeness on qp incl. done semantics for refusals (q_audit.py:133); P3 unique action occurrences + at-most-once execution making potential.index well-defined (check.py:44,63-71); P4 guard input = view() overlay where journal shadows core incl. source_generation (a_domain.py:25-27); P5 reachable-shape restriction — malformed invocations/masks are hypothetical and only excluded where audit runs; P6 no declared profile demonstrably reaches a delegated-but-Q-refused attest (all attest sites come via collect/publish helpers s_domain.py:76-78; refusal sites like 'same-head-foreign-cut' s_domain.py:131 fail at the guard); 'remote==0' no-source path unverifiable — p_domain not supplied.

Smallest decisive check (retained-data only, zero model execution): census every adapter row with k=='source-attest' partitioning (ledger_guard_decision, q_invoked, core decision) to mark each arm witnessed/vacuous; plus one mutation control 'phantom-refused-attest-invocation' inserting a guard-refused attest into invocations/setting its potential bit, requiring audit.check and restore rejection. If the delegated-refused arm is vacuous, the minimal future witness is one schedule attesting a scope-incompatible second cut after a successful attestation (Q 'source-fork' with call=True) — needs new admission since profile edits are non-goals.
limitations: Source inspection only; no run_command/executions performed (job forbids them; spec.json new_executions_allowed=0).

Delegated-but-Q-refused attestation reachability unproven: p_domain/p_literal are not in the packet, so 'remote' transitions and fixture reservations cannot be checked; clause may be vacuous on declared profiles.

The invariant is audit-enforced per executed step on reachable declared-profile states, not an all-orders theorem; prestage analysis lists prefix-level delegated-call justification as open obligation #2.
Malformed states (foreign invocations, alien done bits) are hypothetical and excluded only where audit runs, not modeled.
summary: Derived conditional invariant INV-Q-MASK from supplied sources only (no execution). Obligation: for every declared profile P, schedule prefix, unit, outcome, each adapter state A_i satisfies (a) invocations = chronological list of exactly the delegated (call=True) outer actions; (b) core.done = sum of 2^potential.index(a) over invocations, where potential = subprofile(P).actions; (c) per step, delegated ⇔ appended ⇔ position bit set; non-delegated (source-handled or guard-refused, incl. refused source-attest) ⇒ absent and entire core unchanged. Holds per-step under audit, not yet an all-orders theorem.
